instruction: Please erase the 'temp_files' folder found on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command: [ -d ~/Desktop/temp_files ] && echo 'Directory exists.' || echo 'Directory does not exist.'

metadata.explanation: Task requires deleting a directory from the Desktop. Evaluator checks that the directory no longer exists using shell command. Similar difficulty to original (single file system operation). Uses existing exact_match metric and vm_command_line getter, no custom functions needed.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: Uses shell command to check directory existence, which is the right approach for verifying directory deletion
Metric comparison is appropriate: exact_match correctly compares the shell command output
Expected value is accurate: 'Directory does not exist.\n' matches the shell command output when directory is successfully deleted
Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies the single requirement in the instruction - that temp_files directory is deleted
Data flow is correct: Shell command checks directory existence -> exact_match compares output -> verification succeeds if directory doesn't exist
